in_marathi.name: Bhadrakali
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Victory and Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhadrakali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhadrakali is a form of Goddess Kali, known for her destructive power to destroy evil. She is also revered as the mother who grants victory and prosperity. Her name means 'She Who Brings Good', derived from the Sanskrit words 'bhadra' meaning good and 'kali' meaning time or black color.

Her name means 'She Who Brings Good', derived from the Sanskrit words 'bhadra' meaning good and 'kali' meaning time or black color.
